title: Editor window position is shifted downwards by the title bar's height when restoring after a restart
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Fedora Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (nvidia; 570.86.16) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads)

### Issue description

When restarting the editor, the window will shift downwards ever so slightly after being [restored](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76085). The amount is determined by the window title bar's height:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/06d0fd2c-823e-4caa-8a6f-7b38154a93dd

If you hide the window borders by using a window manager shortcut (I have <kbd>Alt + F12</kbd> configured to do this on KWin), this won't happen:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/783fc36f-933e-4820-944a-70868cbbb08d

This does not affect maximized editor windows, as maximizing forces the window size to match the screen size. This also does not affect windows whose bottom edge is already at the bottom of the screen, since it can't go any lower with automatic positioning.

`Window.get_size_with_decorations()` may be helpful to address this here.

cc @spanzeri – is this related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/76085#discussion_r1985071342?

### Steps to reproduce

- Open a project, exit and restart it multiple times while not having the editor window maximized.

N/A
